edition: Rahlfs–Hanhart 2006; German Bible Society online running text
authorization: User authorized provisional continuation with Rahlfs–Hanhart; Göttingen not obtained.
scope: Rahlfs–Hanhart 2006 remains the user-authorized provisional base. Focused checks of the publisher’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. This is an English editorial revision, not a complete critical-text or apparatus verification. Göttingen, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.
historical_records: Existing index and reference records were consulted as historical reference, not proof of fresh complete Greek verification.

chapters.decision: Modernized ordinary royal address and finite verbs; kept the knowing euphemism, sinners, the repeated invitations, and the earth bursting at the people's sound. Rendered the dismissal at 1:53 as 'Come now, go to your house.'
chapters.pending: Independent review of the oath's negative syntax at 1:51 and the contextual sense of sinners at 1:21; full critical apparatus review.
chapters.english_review: Every existing English verse unit individually read and reviewed.

chapters.decision: Retained Solomon's twelve years, Camps, Hades, the differing Bahurim/Hebron locations, repeated Shimei account, and all lettered additions and skipped letter labels. Ordinary address now uses you/your; source-specific past tenses and figures remain.

chapters.decision: Preserved direct prayer Thou/Thee/Thy/Thine in 3:6–9, but ordinary you/your in God's reply. Clarified the highest place at Gibeon, retaining the superlative.
